description.en: Hylonomus lyelli: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m asset scale (technical contract retained over narrative 0.6m), muted palette, body depth, exact digit lengths and skin artistic. JFI2018 Fig2B whole artwork informs broad shape; Fig2A disarticulated NHM R4168 type anchors identity. Dawson1891 records cranial, shoulder, limb, pelvis and caudal remains; no fossil scan or obsolete taxonomy claim.
